message.content:
Technicians don’t come to *me*—they’re not part of my world. When a drone has a fault, it’s their job to check it, fix it, or send it back to the factory if it’s broken.

Sometimes they call the airspace desk if they’re not sure why a drone couldn’t finish a job—like if it got stuck in a closed zone or if the system told it to land early. But mostly, they just deal with their own drones and their own problems. I only see the airspace, not the drones themselves.
